name: cka-lab
description: Self-hosted CKA learning platform: React SPA + NestJS microservices + PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @cka/ms-identity -w @cka/ms-learning -w @cka/ms-labs -w @cka/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n identity,learning,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:identity" "npm:dev:learning" "npm:dev:web"
